transport.title: Buses to Palma
transport.text: Route A1 connects the airport with central Palma, A2 with S’Arenal, and 34 with Hospital Son Espases. Airport stops for A1 are on Level 0 at arrivals and Level 2 at departures.

taxi.title: Taxi
taxi.text: The marked taxi rank is at arrivals on Level 0 of the terminal. The taxi service number for passengers with reduced mobility is +34 971 703 529.

lounges.title: Valldemossa VIP Lounge
lounges.text: Valldemossa VIP Lounge is on Level 4 in the commercial part of the boarding area, which is accessible only to passengers on Schengen and non-Schengen flights. The lounge is open from 05:00 to midnight; the maximum stay is 3 hours immediately before scheduled departure. It offers catering, workspaces, a printer and flight information.

wifi.title: Free Wi-Fi
wifi.text: Connect to Airport Free Wifi Aena and open the welcome page as a guest with an email address, or sign in to Aena Club. You receive 15 minutes of free access to confirm your email; after confirmation there is no time limit.
